svg.text: RoadSafe AI — User, Admin & Super Admin Flowchart
Municipality of Dagami, Leyte • Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Privilege Boundaries & Real-Time Cloud Synchronization

g.text: ● 🚗 USER (Learner)
● 👮 ADMIN (Officer)
● ⭐ SUPER ADMIN (Chief)
● ☁️ Firestore Sync

svg.text: User inputs credentials (Mobile Jetpack Compose / Web roadsafedrive.com) • SHA-256 + Salt hash verification • Resolves canonical role from Room SQLite & Firestore users/{uid}

g.text: Evaluate Canonical Role
UserRole.fromRoleString()

svg.text: Target Persona: Student drivers, Tricycle operators, Motorcyclists, Citizens seeking LTO compliance.
Access Principle: Educational, assessment & gamification features only. Strict zero-access to administrative tools.

g.text: 1. Registration & Demographic Profiling (SignUpScreen.kt • AuthManager.kt)
• Input Full Name, Username, Age, Gender, Contact Number • Password hashed with SHA-256 + Salt
• Auto-assigns canonical role = "user" • Saves locally in Room SQLite & emits REGISTER to Firestore /activities
2. Learner Dashboard & Navigation Scaffold (RoadSafetyApp.kt • DashboardScreen.kt)
• Personalized welcome HUD, daily streak banner, active XP progress ring, municipal announcements banner
• Bottom navigation: Home (Dashboard), Learn, Simulation, Progress, Profile
3. Traffic Law Curriculum: 10 Modules (AssessmentScreen.kt • LearningModule.kt)
• Topics: Right-of-Way, Traffic Signs, Speed Limits, Overtaking, RA 4136, Distracted Driving (RA 10913)
• Modular reading completion awards +50 XP • Subject to AppConfig.requireModuleBeforeQuiz gating
4. Session-Exclusive Language Selector & Adaptive Exam Engine (QuizScreen.kt)
• Mandatory Pre-Quiz Language Modal: [ 🇬🇧 English ] vs [ 🇵🇭 Filipino / Tagalog ] (Locked until selection made)
• 100-question pools (🟢 Easy, 🟡 Medium, 🔴 Hard) • 15s/20s timer challenges • Combo multiplier (1.0x to 2.5x)
• Passing threshold check (e.g. 70%) • ModuleReviewScreen post-exam review with legal citations
5. Visual Driving Hazard Simulation Engine (SimulationScreen.kt • ChatScenarios.kt)
• 20 Situational Scenarios with weather (Clear, Monsoon Rain, Night Fog) & road grip friction loss (0% to 35%)
• 20-second decision loop • Consequence Tiers (Perfect +100XP / Safe +75XP / Critical Collision 0XP)
6. 100% Offline Edge AI Traffic Tutor ("RoadSafe AI" Coach) (AiTutorScreen.kt)
• Instant edge NLP with bilingual auto-detection (Tagalog/Filipino vs English) • 12 Philippine Traffic Topics
• On-Topic Guard: Respectfully redirects non-traffic queries • Structured 3-part format (Status, Law, Tip)
7. Gamification Economy, Streaks & Municipal Leaderboard (MyProgressScreen.kt)
• Level progression curve (Levels 1 to 50) with confetti celebration modals • Consecutive daily learning streaks
• Unlocks milestone badges • Active participant on public Dagami driver rankings
🛑 ACCESS RESTRICTION BOUNDARY (RolePermissions.hasPermission == false)
• If User attempts to navigate to Admin Panel, User Management, or System Settings:
• Navigation intercepted by AppNavigationDrawer & Route Resolver ➔ Renders AccessDeniedScreen.kt
• Emits security alert to Firestore /audit_logs

svg.text: Target Persona: Dagami MPS Traffic Enforcement Officers, Field Supervisors, LGU Coordinators.
Access Principle: Operational administrative command, citizen directory, curriculum toggles, safety telemetry & AppConfig.

g.text: 1. Dual-Platform Administrative Command Portal (AdminDashboardScreen.kt • roadsafedrive.com)
• Access via Mobile Admin Suite or Web SPA • Real-time telemetry: Active drivers, total quizzes, pass rate
• Leaderboard Exclusion: Officer accounts are excluded from driver rankings to preserve citizen integrity
2. Driver Directory & Account Governance (AdminUserManagementScreen.kt • Web Tab 2)
• Searchable driver directory with demographic filters (Age, Gender, Contact) & full learner history
• Account status control: Activate or deactivate accounts with immediate cloud synchronization
3. Traffic Curriculum & Assessment Bank Management (AdminModuleManagementScreen.kt • Web Tab 3/4)
• Toggle mobile module availability via Firestore system_settings/modules • Review 300-question repository
• Filter by difficulty (Easy, Medium, Hard) • Inspect citizen answer sheets and review RA 4136 citations
4. Hazard Trials Control & AI Query Stream Monitor (Web Tab 5 & Tab 7)
• Launch driving hazard simulations in trial mode to inspect dilemma calibration and road friction parameters
• Live feed of citizen AI queries with bilingual badges (EN vs FIL) • Detect high-frequency road safety doubts
5. Device Fleet Telemetry & Access Logs Stream (Web Tab 8 & Tab 9)
• Track connected Android hardware across Dagami (OS versions Android 11–15, screen sizes, battery status)
• Authentication access logs tracking with device fingerprints, timestamps, and login success/failure states
6. Real-Time Activity Feed (/activities) & CSV Exporter (AdminReportsScreen.kt • Web Tab 10)
• Append-only live stream of citizen actions (LOGIN, QUIZ_COMPLETE, LEVEL_UP) in Philippine Standard Time (PST)
• One-click export of municipal road safety metrics and exam results to official CSV reports
7. Mobile App Configuration & Policy Control Center (AppConfig.kt • Tab 12)
• Passing scores (50% to 100%) • Per-question countdown timers (15s/20s/30s) • Attempt limits (Unlimited, 1, 2, 3)
• Question and choice randomization • Language policy toggles (English & Filipino availability)
• Writes directly to system_settings/app_config: Mobile apps stream updates live via StateFlow
⚠️ ADMINISTRATIVE PRIVILEGE BOUNDARY (Role Elevation Reserved)
• Standard Admins cannot promote users to Admin or demote fellow officers
• Cannot trigger factory defaults or bypass high-risk security audit gates
• Role elevation and municipal emergency lockouts are exclusively delegated to Super Admin

svg.text: ⭐ SUPER ADMIN (MPS Chief / Lead System Administrator)
Target Persona: Dagami MPS Chief of Police, Municipal IT Director, Lead System Architect.
Access Principle: Universal Spectrum Access. Full executive governance, user role promotion/demotion, municipal lockout & reset.

g.text: 1. Universal Spectrum Access & Dual-Portal Sandbox Mode (RolePermissions.kt • Web SPA)
• Inherits 100% of User capabilities + 100% of Traffic Officer capabilities without restriction
• Dual-Portal Switcher: One-click toggle between Admin Command Mode and Learner Simulation Sandbox
2. Executive Role Elevation & Demotion Authority (updateUserRole() in app.js)
• Promote USER ➔ ADMIN: Grants traffic officer powers to citizen account with confirmation modal
• Demote ADMIN ➔ USER: Revokes officer powers and restores standard driver constraints
• Atomically updates Firestore users/{uid} & logs tamper-evident audit record
3. Municipal Emergency Maintenance Mode & Lockout (AppConfig.maintenanceMode)
• Instantly locks all running Android apps across the municipality with a custom administrative notice
• Disables exam taking and hazard simulations during scheduled maintenance or typhoon alerts
4. Minimum App Version & Force Update Enforcement (AppConfig.minAppVersion)
• Enforces minimum baseline build (e.g. v1.2.0) across the entire municipal driver fleet
• When forceUpdate is active, outdated mobile clients are locked with a direct link to roadsafedrive.com/download
5. Tamper-Evident Security Audit Ledger: /audit_logs (AuditDashboardScreen.kt • Web Tab 11)
• Permanent audit trail capturing all administrative and security actions categorized by Risk Level
• Risk Tiers: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL • Inspects role changes, threshold alterations & failed logins
6. System Configuration Factory Reset to Defaults (resetToDefaults() in app.js)
• Reverts all examination scores, timers, streak curves & progression rules to default baseline
• Protected by dual-confirmation modal to prevent accidental execution by field officers
7. Direct Cross-Role Governance & Real-Time Push (Firestore ➔ FirebaseSyncManager)
• Every action taken by Super Admin propagates instantly to all User and Admin devices in the field
• Zero mobile app restarts required • Active sessions adapt to new permissions dynamically

svg.text: ☁️ REAL-TIME CLOUD PROPAGATION & ROLE ELEVATION PIPELINE (Firestore + FirebaseSyncManager)

g.text: Google Cloud Firestore Collections
• users/{uid}: Canonical user record & role string ('user' | 'admin')
• system_settings/app_config: Passing marks, timers, locks
• activities: Append-only event ledger (PST UTC+8)
• audit_logs: Tamper-evident admin action ledger
• user_progress: Citizen XP, levels, badges, streaks
• quiz_attempts: Individual exam scores, answers & languages
Step 1: Role Elevation Trigger
Super Admin modifies user dropdown on Web Command Center & clicks Confirm.
Firestore Call: users/{uid}.set({ role: 'admin' }, merge: true)
Step 2: Tamper-Evident Audit Logging
System commits immutable security event to Firestore audit_logs & activities.
Audit Record: action: 'ROLE_UPDATED', risk: 'MEDIUM', by: @admin
Step 3: Real-Time Mobile Snapshot Catch
Running Android device receives snapshot via FirebaseSyncManager.observeUserRole.
Client Event: AuthManager detects role change from USER to ADMIN
Step 4: Dynamic Zero-Downtime Re-scaffold
Compose updates StateFlow: permissions elevated, drawer switches to Admin Suite.
Toast Notification: "Permissions Updated: Welcome, Traffic Officer"
Policy Propagation Loop (AppConfig Engine):
Any change made to passing scores (50%-100%), per-question timers (15s-30s), language availability (English / Filipino),

or municipal maintenance mode locks writes directly to system_settings/app_config. Connected Android devices stream this via appConfigFlow and apply new policies instantly without requiring an app reboot or user logoff.
